bull_bear.body: Prioritizing project launches and capex for high-return assets (Worli, Commerz III, Thane); no dividends paid; debt reduction secondary to growth; land acquisition via redevelopment and TDRs to minimize cash outflow.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Regulatory delays in Thane (Eco-Sensitive Zone reinstatement risk); interest rate volatility impacting buyer affordability; delays in redevelopment approvals; oversupply risk in non-premium segments; execution risk on large commercial projects.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident, bullish, and proactive; management emphasizes pricing power, supply scarcity, and execution discipline; avoids overpromising on timelines but signals strong momentum; tone reflects control over narrative and market position.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: Buyers are purchasing 2-3 units to create 12,000-15,000 sq.ft duplexes — indicating ultra-high-net-worth demand and asset consolidation behavior, not just housing needs; SRA redevelopment success without intermediaries is a rare competitive moat in Mumbai.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Residential: 360 West (Worli) sold 77/200 units at ₹1.0-1.1 Cr/sq.ft RERA carpet; Goregaon/Borivali sold out Towers A/B; Mulund pricing up 5-10%; Retail: Borivali Mall pre-COVID consumption restored; Commercial: Commerz III nearing completion with strong tenant interest; Redevelopment: SRA site adjacent to Sky City cleared, 95% vacated.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
> Only challenges the company specifically discussed on this call. Names resolved against our own companies/products files + StockMetadata. ✅=covered here, ⭐=sector-knowledge.

| Challenge (their words) | Beneficiary — NSE · BSE | Loser — NSE · BSE | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eco Sensitive Zone/Supreme Court order halted construction activity near fault lines in MMR; caused delay to Thane (Kolshet/Pokhran) and Borivali launches | — | SUNTECK REALTY LIMITED — SUNTECK · 512179 | Oberoi says Eco Sensitive Zone/court order delayed Thane launch; all MMR developers with greenfield Thane/peripheral MMR land similarly impacted by the same regulatory bottleneck in Q2FY23 / Low |
| Input material costs have gone up - steel is a key construction input; company forced to raise prices 5-10% across projects | JSW STEEL LIMITED — JSWSTEEL · 500228 | — | Material cost pressure cited broadly; steel is key construction input; JSW is largest listed steel producer with domestic pricing power in a cost-up cycle / Med |
| Input material costs have gone up - steel, cement and other construction materials; company forced to raise prices 5-10% across projects | ULTRATECH CEMENT LIMITED — ULTRACEMCO · 532538 | — | Vikas Oberoi explicitly cites material costs up; cement is largest construction input; UltraTech as market leader passes through price hikes / High |
| Interest costs going up for developers - cited as a significant headwind alongside input costs, squeezing leveraged developers who cannot raise prices | LIC HOUSING FINANCE LTD — LICHSGFIN · 500253 | — | Oberoi states interest costs risen for developers; HFCs and NBFCs lending to developers earn higher yields in rising rate environment, though asset quality risk also rises for weaker borrowers / Low |
| Lack of credible suppliers - Oberoi explicitly cites this as enabling premium demand and minimal competition, particularly for ready-to-move Worli inventory | OBEROI REALTY LIMITED — OBEROIRLTY · 533273 | — | Self-referential but directly stated: Oberoi says residential business outperforms due to "robust demand and lack of credible suppliers" - they are the supply side scarcity play / High |
| Manpower costs going up - cited explicitly alongside material and approval costs as reasons for price hikes across all projects | TEAMLEASE SERVICES LTD. — TEAMLEASE · 539658 | — | Vikas Oberoi explicitly says manpower costs up; TeamLease as leading construction/general workforce staffing player benefits from tighter labour markets and higher bill rates / Med |
| Rising input and interest costs threatening delivery viability of smaller/weaker developers - Oberoi says he fears other developers cannot deliver if they do not raise prices | — | LODHA DEVELOPERS LIMITED — LODHA · 543287 | Oberoi says smaller/less credible developers face delivery risk given cost surge; Lodha (then recently listed) carried high leverage and similar MMR exposure, making it representative of this risk / Low |

latest_quarter.body: Residential margins expanding due to pricing power (Worli realization up 50% YoY); input costs up 15-20% (labor, materials, approvals); 5-10% price hikes implemented across projects since Oct 2022; commercial margins expected to be 35%+ post-completion.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Launches planned in Thane, Borivali, and Goregaon within Q3FY23; Glaxo land use decision (residential vs. commercial) expected by end of Q3FY23; no formal guidance issued beyond near-term launches.
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: ₹12,500 Cr (including ₹8,500 Cr from Worli 360 West unsold inventory and ₹4,000 Cr from other projects)
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: Glaxo land parcel (10+ acres) for commercial/mall or residential; redevelopment pipeline in Mumbai (multiple projects in advanced talks); potential for 1M sq.ft commercial expansion in Borivali/Sky City corridor; expansion beyond MMR under evaluation.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Oberoi Realty is capitalizing on acute supply constraints in Mumbai's premium residential market with high-margin, ready-to-move-in projects like Worli's 360 West, while strategically advancing commercial and redevelopment pipelines that offer multi-year growth visibility and pricing power amid rising input costs.
